office_does: Port of Pasco commissioners govern the port district, which runs the Tri-Cities Airport, the Big Pasco and Reimann industrial centers and other economic development property.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Port Commission President Hans-Joachim Engelke, appointed in January 2025 and elected to a one-year term in November 2025, is the only candidate. Only District 3 voters see this race, the first by-district port election.

candidates.summary: Basin City farmer appointed to the Port of Pasco commission in 2025 and its president since January 2026; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Commission president since January 2026; appointed January 2025 [S1]
Backs growth around the airport and industrial centers [S1]
